title: A review delegation cut by a host restart loses its unsubmitted review progress; no supported way to save and recover partial review bookkeeping
outcome: A review delegation cut by a host restart loses its unsubmitted review progress; no supported way to save and recover partial review bookkeeping
acceptance: A review delegation has a supported way to durably record partial review progress (commands run, files inspected, provisional findings) before its final submission, and after a host restart the recovered child (or its follow-up attempt) can read that recorded progress back; a test restarts the host mid-review and shows the progress survives.

Recorded partial progress is never counted as a submitted review, review credit or coverage by itself; only a final submission is, and a test shows an interrupted review with saved progress still reports no submitted result.
The interrupted child's result names the interruption and points to the saved progress, so the parent can follow up the same child instead of starting a new review; a test shows it.
